metadata.title: त्रिपुरा: आदिवासी किसानों को मदद का इंतज़ार | Tripura : primitive agriculture to cash crops
metadata.description: There was a time when Jhoom or Shift cultivation was prevalent in the tribal areas of Tripura. But in last 2 decades the situation has drastically changed. The tribes of Tripura are not only giving up Jhoom cultivation but adopting modern and cash crops. Now they are aspiring for a better world for them. our correspondent Salain Kalai brings you the story of this positive change in the state of Tripura.
